source.title: Coffee Rush Eastridge — what ADVO shipped, read from advo-ph/coffeerush
source.summary: A three-page site for the Angono cafe: a scroll-locked photographic intro through the drinks and the kitchen, a fully priced menu, and a browser-side order builder.

meta.provenance: case-study.ts, each feature cites a file in the client repo

fact.claim: Coffee Rush Eastridge is a Cafe · Angono, Rizal build: A three-page site for the Angono cafe: a scroll-locked photographic intro through the drinks and the kitchen, a fully priced menu, and a browser-side order builder.
fact.quote: A three-page site for the Angono cafe: a scroll-locked photographic intro through the drinks and the kitchen, a fully priced menu, and a browser-side order builder.

fact.claim: Coffee Rush Eastridge: Scroll-locked drink intro — Scrolling into the intro locks the page and steps through eight drink photographs by wheel, touch or arrow key. After the last one the cups morph into a ring around the logo and zoom out.
fact.quote: Scrolling into the intro locks the page and steps through eight drink photographs by wheel, touch or arrow key. After the last one the cups morph into a ring around the logo and zoom out.

fact.claim: Coffee Rush Eastridge: Kitchen strip — A horizontal run of eight plated dishes tracks scroll position and releases the lock at the end. Scrolling back up re-enters the scene rather than skipping it.
fact.quote: A horizontal run of eight plated dishes tracks scroll position and releases the lock at the end. Scrolling back up re-enters the scene rather than skipping it.

fact.claim: Coffee Rush Eastridge: Priced menu — Sixteen categories from Hot Coffee Classics to Open-Face Sandwiches, rendered from a catalogue in the page with real peso prices, plus Cloud Series cards listing each flavour.
fact.quote: Sixteen categories from Hot Coffee Classics to Open-Face Sandwiches, rendered from a catalogue in the page with real peso prices, plus Cloud Series cards listing each flavour.

fact.claim: Coffee Rush Eastridge: Order builder — Roughly 97 items across category tabs with quantity steppers, a sticky cart with line totals and subtotal, and a mobile bar that appears once the cart is not empty.
fact.quote: Roughly 97 items across category tabs with quantity steppers, a sticky cart with line totals and subtotal, and a mobile bar that appears once the cart is not empty.

fact.claim: Coffee Rush Eastridge: Visit details — The cafe's own copy: Eastridge in Angono, Rizal, open 7AM to 2AM daily, with the Azotea VIP function room for private and corporate bookings.
fact.quote: The cafe's own copy: Eastridge in Angono, Rizal, open 7AM to 2AM daily, with the Azotea VIP function room for private and corporate bookings.

fact.claim: Coffee Rush Eastridge runs on Vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript — no bundler, no framework.
fact.quote: Vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript — no bundler, no framework

fact.claim: Coffee Rush Eastridge runs on Three static pages: index, menu, order.
fact.quote: Three static pages: index, menu, order

fact.claim: Coffee Rush Eastridge runs on IntersectionObserver scroll reveals.
Coffee Rush Eastridge integrates: Google Fonts for Fraunces and Hanken Grotesk.
fact.quote: Google Fonts for Fraunces and Hanken Grotesk

fact.claim: Coffee Rush Eastridge integrates: Outbound Instagram profile links.
